title: NIST World Trade Center Reports (NCSTAR 1 & 1A)
summary: Federal Building and Fire Safety Investigation of the World Trade Center Disaster. Concludes each tower collapsed from aircraft impact damage, dislodged fireproofing and multi-floor fires — floor trusses sagged, pulled exterior columns inward, progressive collapse. WTC 7 (NCSTAR 1A, Nov 2008): thermal expansion failed Column 79 — 'the first known instance of the total collapse of a tall building primarily due to fires.' NIST's FAQ directly rebuts controlled demolition/thermite: no blast evidence; a thermite operation would have needed many thousands of pounds placed inconspicuously.
